
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
```
```{r}
header <- c('sourceTaxonIDs',
            'sourceTaxonName',
            'sourceTaxonLevel',
            'sourceSpeciesName',
            'sourcePhylum',
            'sourceKingdom',
            'interactionType',
            'targetTaxonIDs',
            'targetTaxonName',
            'targetTaxonLevel', 
            'targetSpeciesName',
            'targetPhylum',
            'targetKingdom')

#reading in GLOBI output
interactions_sources <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/secundary_interactions_sources_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header)

interactions_targets <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/secundary_interactions_targets_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header) 
 
primary_interactions <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/vespa_velutina_interactions_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header) 

raw_interactions <- rbind(interactions_sources,
                          interactions_targets,
                          primary_interactions)
```


```{r}
#remove refuted interactions
refuted_interactions <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/refuted_interactions_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header) 

raw_interactions <- raw_interactions%>%
  mutate(id = paste0(sourceSpeciesName, 
                     sourceTaxonName,
                     interactionType,
                     targetTaxonName,
                     targetSpeciesName))

refuted_interactions <- refuted_interactions%>%
  mutate(id = paste0(sourceSpeciesName, 
                     sourceTaxonName,
                     interactionType,
                     targetTaxonName,
                     targetSpeciesName))

test <- raw_interactions%>%
  filter(id%in%refuted_interactions$id)

raw_interactions_cleaned <- raw_interactions %>%
  filter(!id%in%refuted_interactions$id)

write.csv(raw_interactions_cleaned, 'raw_interactions_cleaned.csv')
```
